title: OpenTelemetry Span ID
summary: An OpenTelemetry span ID is a 64-bit (8-byte) identifier that uniquely identifies a span within a trace. Represented as 16 lowercase hex characters. Each span in a trace has a unique span ID.

notes: 64 bits (8 bytes), represented as 16 hex characters.
Parent span ID references the parent span.
Used in distributed tracing for span correlation.
W3C Trace Context: traceparent header carries the span ID.
